title: What great food storage containers! I love them!
text: What great food storage containers! I love them!. I really love these! First they are relatively heavy (glass) and super durable. I love that I can make a meal, store it in the container, freeze it and then place it in the oven or microwave when I am ready to eat it.  These are dishwasher safe, seal perfectly and are now one of my most used items daily in my busy home. I highly recommend these to everyone who needs a quick easy way to store meals. Whether you want to use these strictly in your kitchen or carry them to work or school with meals these are perfect. Would also make a great gift during the holidays for the person in your life who has everything.
